name: Tiger and Leopard Cavalry
headerMeta: Golden era · Cavalry · charge · 310 leadership · Chaos Season (T5)
pitch: A newly-buffed elite lancer cavalry that stacks passive damage the longer it charges. Build for maximum charge-cooldown reduction and respect the damage scaling — start charges as far as you can and watch the passive stack.

doctrines.name: Lancer's Last Stand
doctrines.note: +40% DMG at <60% headcount; swap out then back to apply to full strength

doctrines.name: Epic Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.note: −50% DMG taken while charging, −6s charge CD

doctrines.name: Toughness Doctrine
doctrines.note: −33% DMG taken on first hit, scales down through 8 hits

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Recommended by Amya for primary use.

battleRole.positioning: No explicit positioning guidance in sources.
battleRole.tips: Respect the passive and charge from as far as you can — the longer the charge, the more speed and passive damage stack. {1} Ability rotation: press 1 (simple charge) → 2 (area impact, similar to Liaos or Kheshig) → 3 (crowd control cleanse and charge again); typical play is 1 → 2 → 3 repeat. {1}

controls.notes: Ability 1: simple charge. {1} Ability 2: area-impact damage, similar to Liaos or Kheshig. {1} Ability 3: crowd control cleanse + charge out. {1} Charge length scales both movement speed and passive damage — longer charge = bigger payoff. {1}

gaps: No counters section, hero pairing, or conditional matchups in any source.
